status.summary: Adani Enterprises' results presentation for the quarter ended 30 September 2026, submitted to BSE and NSE on 28 October 2026, gives in the 'Data Centers Status' table of its AdaniConneX slide, under Navi Mumbai (460 MW total growth, no operational capacity), 'Ghansoli - 220 MW| Execution started' and, separately, 'Taloja – 240 MW| New Order Received'. This records that execution of AdaniConneX's Ghansoli campus had started as of the 28 October 2026 filing, which is read as construction under way: the same table sets it apart from Taloja's order stage, from Noida's completed core and shell, and from completed or operational phases elsewhere. The presentation does not say when works began, which buildings are being built or how far they have progressed; 220 MW is the planned capacity of the site, not capacity built or in service.

locator.precision: Project coordinate printed in the SEIAA Maharashtra environmental clearance for data-centre project ACXNMI-01 on Plot No. A-GEN-4, TTC MIDC Rabale, Ghansoli (25.19 ha). It locates the campus plot as a whole, not a particular data-centre building, a surveyed boundary, an entrance or the part of the plot where works have started.
locator.identity_review: SEIAA Maharashtra environmental clearance EC23B039MH131196 of 11 December 2023 (SIA/MH/INFRA2/438248/2023), which AdaniConneX publishes on its own About Us page as 'EC Certificate of ACXNMI-1 by M/s Support Properties Pvt. Ltd.', prints 'Latitude -19°7'7.56"N, Longitude: 73°0 '31.80"E' (19.1187667 N, 73.0088333 E) for the 'Proposed Data Center Project "ACXNMI-01"' at Plot No. A-GEN-4, T.T.C. Industrial Area, MIDC Rabale, Village Savli, Ghansoli, Navi Mumbai, on a plot of 2,51,934.30 m2 with seven G+6 data-centre buildings. Adani Enterprises' Q2 FY27 presentation names Ghansoli as one of AdaniConneX's two Navi Mumbai sites (Ghansoli 220 MW, Taloja 240 MW); the EC's village is Ghansoli and no other AdaniConneX project in Ghansoli was found, so the EC plot is taken to be the Ghansoli campus. The EC states no MW figure, so the link between the presentation's 220 MW site and this plot rests on the shared place name and on AdaniConneX presenting the EC as its own. Visual check only, not used to derive the point or the status: on an Esri World Imagery export of about 1 km around the point (captured 6 November 2026, imagery date not stated) the point falls on a building site with a grid of foundations and concrete column stubs, site cabins and plant inside a large walled tract of cleared land. The coordinate's datum is not stated and is taken as WGS84 without transformation; the proponent's registered office in Andheri East, Mumbai, is not used, and no map service, map link or embedded map parameter was used.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The EC states no datum, survey method or positional accuracy for its coordinate, and the point stands for a 25.19 ha plot (roughly 500 m across) whose boundary is not published.

status.summary: Getworks, Tokyo Gas Engineering Solutions (TGES) and Nippon Paper announced on 5 November 2026 that they have signed land-use and power-supply contracts to carry out a container data-centre business at Nippon Paper's Kushiro works (日本製紙釧路事業所) in Kushiro, Hokkaido. Getworks will plan, design, build and operate the container data centre; TGES coordinates the business and builds the foundations, water supply and electrical works; and Nippon Paper provides the works land and power from its existing receiving and generating plant. The companies plan 6 MW in operation within FY2026 and about 40 MW in September 2027, with potential for up to 150 MW. These are targets: no permit, physical work or operation is reported, so the project is recorded as announced on the release date.

status.summary: Equinix's news post of 20 October 2026 on its own community site introduces EPIC as liquid-cooling environments 'operating inside active Equinix IBX® data centers' and lists 'Frankfurt (FR6)' among the locations where EPIC environments are 'currently available'. Equinix's German release of 22 October, datelined Frankfurt, adds that EPIC 'ist ab sofort in Frankfurt ... verfügbar' and that every EPIC location is inside a running Equinix data centre. This records FR6 as an active, operating Equinix IBX colocation data centre on 20 October 2026, the post's date. It is not an opening date (Equinix opened FR6 in June 2017). EPIC is a customer test environment inside FR6 and is not the project; no capacity or IT load is recorded.

locator.precision: Official City of Frankfurt building-address point for Lärchenstraße 110 (address object DEHEFALK30007b3M), the address Equinix publishes for FR6 and also for FR4 on its Lärchenstrasse campus. It locates the campus at that registered address, not FR6's building footprint, a parcel or the campus boundary; the campus also includes FR8 at Lärchenstraße 141, whose address point is 117 m to the north-west.
locator.identity_review: Equinix's 20 October 2026 post names 'Frankfurt (FR6)' as an active IBX. Equinix's FR6 page (Internet Archive raw copy of 3 October 2026; www.equinix.com refuses robots.txt) says 'Frankfurt FR6 is one of three IBX facilities in our Lärchenstrasse campus' and gives the address Laerchenstrasse 110, 65933 Frankfurt, with 6,600 m2 of colocation space in a 4-storey purpose-built building. The FR4 page (copy of 15 October 2026) gives the same address, Larchenstrasse 110, and the FR8 page (copy of 3 October 2026) places FR8 'in the Lärchenstrasse Campus' at Larchenstrasse 141, 65933 Frankfurt. The city geoportal returns exactly one building-address feature for 'Lärchenstraße 110'; 139, 141 and 141a are separate address objects. The geoportal configuration declares EPSG:25832 for this address index, and the point was transformed with pyproj 3.7.1 (round trip under 1 mm). The coordinate in the map widget on Equinix's page was not used, nor any commercial map, geocoder, city centre or head-office address. Equinix's 2013 and 2017 releases called its Frankfurt campus 'Campus Kleyer' after the Kleyer 90 carrier hotel (Kleyerstraße 90, about 3 km east); its current pages place FR4 and FR6 at Lärchenstraße 110 in Griesheim.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The address register publishes no positional accuracy. The point is a single address point shared by FR4 and FR6; Equinix does not publish where the FR6 building stands on the campus, which reaches at least to Lärchenstraße 141 (FR8), 117 m away.
